subject: dsa
title: Two Sum
summary: Scan once, keeping a map of value to index. For each number, check the map for its complement (target - num) before storing the number itself.
problem: Return the indices of the two numbers in nums that add up to target.

steps.caption: For each number we need target - num. Keep a map of value to index so every lookup is O(1). Here target = 9.
First number is 2 (index 0). It needs 7. The map is empty, so 7 is a miss. Store 2 -> 0.
Next is 7 (index 1). It needs 2. Look up 2 - hit, at index 0. That's the pair.
Found in one pass: nums[0] + nums[1] = 2 + 7 = 9. Answer: [0, 1].
